title: Aztecs' Ingenious Floating Gardens
reason: Describes the concept and benefits of the Chinampas agricultural system.

tasks.task: Explain the creation and basic setup of Chinampas.

subtasks.text: Describe how the Aztecs created small, rectangular plots of fertile land on shallow lake beds.
Explain that farmers constructed the gardens by piling mud and decaying vegetation.

tasks.task: Describe the benefits and results of using Chinampas.

subtasks.text: Note that Chinampas resulted in highly productive soil, increasing crop yields significantly.
Highlight how Chinampas allowed the Aztecs to support a large population.

tasks.task: Explain the plants that thrived in the Chinampas environment.

subtasks.text: Mention that maize, beans, and squash thrived in this nutrient-rich environment.

tasks.task: Discuss the sustainable aspects and long-term impact of the Chinampas system.

subtasks.text: Describe how Chinampas maximized space and showcased the Aztecs' advanced understanding of irrigation.
State that the Chinampas system laid the groundwork for modern agriculture techniques.
